camel_example: aliyun ndr CreateBlockingPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --BlockingType ip --BlockingDirection in --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a blocking task for a specified IPv4 address or domain name
description_zh: 为指定 IPv4 地址或域名创建封禁任务
kebab_example: aliyun ndr create-blocking-policy --blocking-type ip --blocking-entity 203.0.113.10 --blocking-direction in --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBlockingPolicy

parameters.help_en: Required. The object type to block. Only ip (IPv4 address) and domain (domain name) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: Required. The object to block. For the ip type, the value must be a single IPv4 address. IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. For the domain type, the value must be a domain name. IP literals and the wildcard character (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a dot and cannot exceed 253 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en: Required. The direction of the blocking task. in indicates inbound, out indicates outbound, and bidirectional indicates both directions. For the domain type, only out is supported
parameters.help_zh: 调用时必填。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向；domain 类型仅支持 out
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The description of the blocking reason. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: blocking_reason

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated security event. This parameter is optional and is not used to locate the blocking policy
parameters.help_zh: 关联安全事件 ID，可不传；不用于定位封禁策略
parameters.name: incident_id

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the blocking task. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is omitted or set to 0, the blocking task never expires. A non-zero value cannot be earlier than the time when the API is called
parameters.help_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。省略或传 0 表示永不过期；非零值不得早于调用时刻
parameters.name: blocking_expire_time

parameters.help_en: The language parameter for compatibility. This parameter does not affect the business results or error messages of this API operation and is optional
parameters.help_zh: 兼容语言参数，当前不影响本接口的业务结果及错误说明，可不传
parameters.name: lang

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

TaskItems.description_en: The list of blocking tasks created in this request. One task is created for unidirectional blocking, and two tasks are created for bidirectional blocking. Successful creation does not indicate that the blocking has taken effect
TaskItems.description_zh: 本次创建的封禁任务列表，单向一条、双向两条；成功创建不表示封禁已生效

items.description_en: The information about an asynchronous task created in this request
items.description_zh: 一条本次新建的异步任务信息

BlockingDirection.description_en: The direction of the asynchronous task. A value of in indicates inbound, and a value of out indicates outbound. A bidirectional operation is split into two tasks
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 本条异步任务的方向，in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向；双向操作拆成两条任务

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the object to block
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名

BlockingType.description_en: The object type to block. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address, and a value of domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

TaskType.description_en: The type of the task. The value is fixed to 0, which indicates manual blocking
TaskType.description_zh: 本条任务的类型，固定为 0，表示手动封禁

TaskUuid.description_en: The UUID of the create task node. You can pass this UUID to the TaskUuids parameter of DescribeBlockingTaskStatus to query the execute result
TaskUuid.description_zh: 本条新建任务的 UUID，可传入 DescribeBlockingTaskStatus 的 TaskUuids 查询执行结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. If the request is successful, an empty string is returned. For example, InvalidParam indicates that the request parameters are invalid, which is not an error code for a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully, and a value of false indicates that the request fails. For an asynchronous API operation, a success response does not indicate that the task has been completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
